housing: Portland renters live in older houses and small apartment buildings on the east side and in mid-rises in the Pearl District and downtown.

localRules.text: Portland's security deposit ordinance requires landlords to give tenants a condition report to complete at the start of the tenancy, and it limits deposits for renters who moved in on or after March 1, 2020.

climate: Look for mold, condensation and leaks around windows; long rainy winters make damp a common issue.
fact: In Portland the move-in condition report is part of the city's deposit rules, so filling it in carefully protects your deposit.
